title: NewTestSqlKvBackend takes a bool (backwardsCompatible), not a mode enum
answers: How do I create a test SQL KV backend for unified storage tests?
What happened to SQLKVBackendMode / SQLKVBackendModeRVManager / SQLKVBackendModeLeases?
Why does NewTestSqlKvBackend take a bool now?
body: Fix pattern: the SQLKVBackendMode enum (RVManager/Leases/OptimisticLocking) was collapsed into a single bool parameter since plain optimistic-locking mode no longer exists as a backend configuration. NewTestSqlKvBackend(t, ctx, backwardsCompatible bool) in pkg/storage/unified/testing/storage_backend_sql_compatibility.go: true wires an rvmanager.ResourceVersionManager for legacy SQL compat, false sets kvOpts.Holder for plain lease-based KV. Constraints: when writing new integration/benchmark tests for the SQL-backed KV store, call this with a bool, not a mode constant — the old constants (SQLKVBackendModeRVManager etc.) no longer exist in this package.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/testing/storage_backend_sql_compatibility.go NewTestSqlKvBackend and its callers in pkg/storage/unified/testing and pkg/storage/unified/sql/test
says: How do I set up a test database for the new storage backend?
Test setup fails because SQLKVBackendMode parameter no longer exists?
Old backend mode options don't work in test configuration anymore?
What boolean value should I pass to create a test storage backend?
Storage backend test setup changed from enum modes to simple boolean?
search: NewTestSqlKvBackend in pkg/storage/unified/testing/storage_backend_sql_compatibility.go takes a bool parameter (backwardsCompatible), not a mode enum, because the SQLKVBackendMode enum (RVManager, Leases, OptimisticLocking) was collapsed and plain optimistic-locking mode no longer exists. Pass true to wire rvmanager.ResourceVersionManager for legacy SQL compatibility, false to set kvOpts.Holder for lease-based KV. The old mode constants (SQLKVBackendModeRVManager, etc.) no longer exist in this package; use this bool signature when writing integration or benchmark tests for SQL-backed KV store in pkg/storage/unified.
